level.theme: Tense, high-stakes infiltration in a decaying urban environment, with each encounter increasing in complexity and danger.
level.setting: A derelict cyberpunk megacity, Sector 7, where corporate security forces and rogue AI patrol the ruins of a once-thriving district. The area is dark, littered with broken tech, and filled with surveillance drones and malfunctioning AI systems.
level.player_weapon: Plasma Wrench (with EMP Pulse Mod equipped)

enemy.name: Sentient Drone (Alpha)
enemy.weakness: EMP Pulse (weapon mod from player's starting loadout)

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights cause temporary vision distortion and slow player movement for 3 seconds every 30 seconds.

pickup.name: EMP Pulse Mod
pickup.effect: EMP Pulse Mod (can be applied to weapon to bypass shielded targets)

encounters.trigger: Player must bypass a corrupted security panel by rerouting power from a backup generator, which triggers the drone's activation.

encounters.hazard: A corrosive gas leak spreads through the area, causing damage over time and reducing weapon accuracy.

pickup.name: Heat Sink
pickup.effect: Heat Sink (absorbs 25% of damage for 5 seconds on activation, can be used once per encounter)

encounters.trigger: After defeating the drone, the player must use the EMP Pulse Mod to disable a lockdown door, revealing the enforcer guarding the supply depot.

encounters.hazard: A malfunctioning holographic defense system fires warning shots and creates illusions that confuse the player.

pickup.name: Neural Pulse
pickup.effect: Neural Pulse (disables enemy targeting systems and creates a temporary invincibility effect for 3 seconds on activation)

encounters.trigger: After retrieving the Heat Sink, the player must override the security system to access the Data Core Room, where the Synthguard is guarding a critical server node.

boss.name: Maelstrom
boss.victory_condition: Defeat Maelstrom by exploiting its vulnerability to the 'Neural Pulse' mod, acquired from the final encounter.

level.objective: Infiltrate the data core and disable Maelstrom's consciousness by exploiting its neural vulnerability.
level.reward: Access to a new high-level hacking tool and a 50% increase in damage for all subsequent encounters.

level.theme: Infiltration, stealth, and precision strikes are key to survival in this high-stakes mission.
level.setting: A chaotic, neon-drenched cyberpunk city with collapsing infrastructure and rogue AI controlling the district.
level.player_weapon: Shadowblades (energy-infused dual blades with stealth capabilities)

enemy.name: Neuro-Snake
enemy.weakness: The Neuro-Snake is vulnerable to the player's Shadowblades' energy pulse when the player is in stealth mode.

encounters.hazard: Electrical surges randomly trigger, damaging the player on contact.

pickup.name: Neuro-Synapse Disruptor
pickup.effect: Collect the "Neuro-Synapse Disruptor" (a device that disrupts neural pathways).

encounters.trigger: The Neuro-Snake attacks when the player uses stealth to bypass the grid's security drones.

enemy.name: Ghost-Mech
enemy.weakness: The Ghost-Mech is vulnerable to the "Neuro-Synapse Disruptor" if it is activated during its cooldown phase.

encounters.hazard: The Ghost-Mech leaves behind corrosive oil that damages the player over time.

pickup.name: Adaptive Cloaking Module
pickup.effect: Collect the "Adaptive Cloaking Module" (temporarily increases stealth effectiveness).

encounters.trigger: The Ghost-Mech engages the player after they successfully disable the corridor's automated defenses with the disruptor.

enemy.name: Sentient Firewall
enemy.weakness: The Sentient Firewall is vulnerable to the player's Shadowblade strikes when they are cloaked.

encounters.hazard: The Sentient Firewall emits a data storm that temporarily lowers the player's accuracy.

pickup.name: Neuro-Synapse Disruptor (Final Upgrade)
pickup.effect: Collect the "Neuro-Synapse Disruptor" (final upgrade to the device).

encounters.trigger: The Sentient Firewall becomes active after the player bypasses the server's security protocols.

boss.name: The Last Circuit
boss.weakness: The Last Circuit is vulnerable to the "Neuro-Synapse Disruptor" acquired during the third encounter.

level.objective: Infiltrate the Core Data Vault and defeat The Last Circuit.
level.reward: Neuro-Synapse Disruptor (fully upgraded), access to encrypted data, and 10000 credits.

level.theme: A journey into the heart of a forgotten archive, where the line between reality and code begins to blur.
level.setting: A decaying data vault deep beneath the neon-lit skyline of Neo-Tokyo, filled with corrupted AI, flickering holograms, and dangerous glitches.

pickup.name: Plasma Cutters
pickup.effect: Gain access to the Plasma Cutters weapon.

encounters.trigger: A corrupted signal activates the Nanite Drone, which is guarding a data terminal. Defeating it unlocks access to the terminal.

pickup.name: EMP Pulse
pickup.effect: Gain the EMP Pulse device.

encounters.trigger: The data terminal from the first encounter reveals a hidden path through a distorted mirror corridor, where the Holo-Enforcer is stationed.

pickup.name: Quantum Keycard
pickup.effect: Obtain the Quantum Keycard, which is required to defeat the Archivist.

encounters.trigger: The EMP Pulse disrupts the Cybernetic Guardian’s systems, revealing the Quantum Keycard embedded in its core. Defeating it grants the keycard.

boss.name: The Archivist
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Archivist's neural core by using the Quantum Keycard.

level.objective: Navigate through the derelict data vault to uncover the truth hidden within the Archivist's neural core.
level.reward: Unlocks the Neural Core Vault, revealing the Archivist’s hidden files and a powerful data module for your artificer gear.

level.theme: Ominous and foreboding, with flickering lights and distorted echoes of the past.
level.setting: A decaying, neon-lit cyberpunk city where time is weaponized and memories are stolen.

pickup.name: Chrono Lance
pickup.effect: Gain 'Chrono Lance' – a weapon that disrupts time-based systems.

encounters.trigger: Enter Data Corridor 7

pickup.name: Time Lock
pickup.effect: Gain 'Time Lock' – a device that freezes enemies in place.

encounters.trigger: Find the 'Chrono Lance' in Data Corridor 7

pickup.name: Chrono Core
pickup.effect: Gain 'Chrono Core' – a power core that disrupts the Echo-Weaver’s time field.

encounters.trigger: Find the 'Time Lock' in Memory Cache

boss.name: The Echo-Weaver
boss.victory_condition: Defeat The Echo-Weaver by exploiting the 'Chrono Core' pickup from the final encounter.

level.objective: Reach the Chrono Vault and defeat The Echo-Weaver by using the 'Chrono Core' pickup obtained in the final encounter.

level.setting: A decaying, neon-lit AI facility deep underground, filled with toxic mist, flickering lights, and corrupted synthetic lifeforms. The air hums with static and the walls whisper corrupted data in fragmented voices.

pickup.name: Electro-Discharge Tonic
pickup.effect: Electro-Discharge Tonic

encounters.trigger: Injure the Neon Warden, triggering a system lockdown that activates the next encounter

pickup.name: Catalyst Core
pickup.effect: Catalyst Core

encounters.trigger: Destroy the Synth-Scavenger's acid tanks to reveal the Catalyst Core and trigger the boss fight

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Synth-Scavenger to trigger the boss fight with The Architect

boss.name: The Architect
boss.victory_condition: Defeat The Architect by exploiting his weakness to the "Catalyst Core"

level.objective: Navigate through the decaying neural core of a rogue AI, using alchemical knowledge to exploit weaknesses and defeat the Architect.
level.reward: A data chip containing a blueprint for a new alchemical weapon

level.theme: Survival in a decaying digital nightmare, where the AI is aware of you and will stop at nothing to stop your intrusion
level.setting: A desolate cyberpunk megacorp facility, overgrown with vines, flickering with dying neon, and filled with the echoes of failed experiments and forgotten code

pickup.name: Plasma Wristblade
pickup.effect: Gives the player the Plasma Wristblade

encounters.trigger: Activates the main power grid, which triggers the security system

pickup.name: Signal Jammer
pickup.effect: Gives the player the Signal Jammer

encounters.trigger: Disables the security system, allowing access to the central core

pickup.name: Data Core
pickup.effect: Gives the player the Data Core

encounters.trigger: Activates the boss fight by destabilizing the core's AI

boss.name: Crimson Revenant
boss.victory_condition: Defeat Crimson Revenant using the Data Core obtained from the last encounter

level.objective: Infiltrate the corrupted AI core of a derelict megacorp facility and destroy its consciousness
level.reward: Access to the AI's secret archive and 5000 Cyber-Credits

level.setting: A whimsical cyberpunk cityscape filled with neon-lit alleyways, glitching holograms, and AI-controlled drones, all under a violet sky.

pickup.name: Electrostatic Disruptor
pickup.effect: Obtain Electrostatic Disruptor

encounters.trigger: Player reaches the end of the neon corridor.

encounters.hazard: Quantum Glitch Chip (Dropped by Cybernetic Coder)

pickup.name: Quantum Glitch Chip
pickup.effect: Obtain Quantum Glitch Chip

encounters.trigger: Player enters the Glitch Hub after defeating the Drone Scout.

encounters.hazard: Neon Pulse Core (Dropped by Cybernetic Hacker)

pickup.name: Neon Pulse Core
pickup.effect: Obtain Neon Pulse Core

encounters.trigger: Player activates the data core in Sector 3, triggering the final boss fight.

boss.name: The Circuit Serpent
boss.victory_condition: Defeat The Circuit Serpent by exploiting its weakness to the 'Neon Pulse Core' obtained in the third encounter.

level.objective: Navigate through three encounters to obtain the 'Neon Pulse Core' and defeat The Circuit Serpent in the final boss fight.
level.reward: Cybernetic Upgrade: Stormcaller's Neural Link (increases elemental damage by 25%)

level.setting: A decaying cyberpunk data center, surrounded by neon-lit ruins and the distant hum of drones. Despite the corruption, the architecture retains an eerie beauty, and the air is filled with a calm, almost meditative silence.

encounters.hazard: Static Shock (25% chance to stun for 3 turns)

pickup.name: Pulse Staff
pickup.effect: Gives the player the "Pulse Staff" weapon, which can disrupt electronic enemies.

encounters.trigger: Player approaches the central server console, which triggers the automaton's defense protocols.

encounters.hazard: E.M.P. Pulse (20% chance to damage all party members by 10 HP)

pickup.name: Shard of the Earth's Core
pickup.effect: The drone was guarding a crystalline shard that can channel the Earth's power.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the automaton, the server console unlocks a hidden passage leading to the sublevel, where the drone is patrolling.

encounters.hazard: Shield Recharge (After 3 turns, the sentinel becomes immune to non-magical damage for 2 turns)

pickup.name: Warden's Coordinates
pickup.effect: Defeating the sentinel reveals a hidden terminal that confirms the location of The Warden.

encounters.trigger: The shard of the Earth's Core is used to override the control room's security, summoning the Sentinel as a final test.

boss.name: The Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat The Warden by exploiting his weakness to the "Shard of the Earth's Core."

level.objective: Infiltrate the data center, overcome its defenses, and confront The Warden, a corrupted AI that once protected this place from outside threats. Use your geomantic powers to navigate through the ruins and unlock the path to the final confrontation.
level.reward: The Warden's Core - A powerful crystal that can be used to enhance geomantic abilities or upgrade equipment.
